Five unmerged branches confirmed: four in empressa-trading, one in smart-markets.

SQUASH MERGES BREAK THE ANCESTRY TEST. tw68/deploy-gate is content-merged as 236c1be2 but `git branch --merged` will never list it, because a squash commit is not a descendant of the branch. mergedLocalBranches() uses `--merged main`, so squash-merged branches are permanently invisible to the prune report. This errs toward under-pruning and is safe, but it means the report will never propose deleting them and someone will eventually delete them by hand outside the safety signals.

mergedLocalBranches() compares against LOCAL main, not origin/main. Empressa Trading's local main is 4 behind, so branches merged in those 4 revisions read as unmerged. Also the safe direction, also worth knowing.

BP-01 2026-08-19: operator bulkRule BP-01-ldt-historical-merged asserts prune-safe for merged LDT locals with no worktree and tip before 2026-08-01, excluding replit-incoming. Named unknown rows hold the August 16 and replit-incoming. This is an assertion, not a scanner inference. 65 worktree-attached LDT locals stay undeclared and blocked.
